## History

Lettie Marchant is an imaginary character created by [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) during her stay at Mrs. Thomas's home. [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) imagined her as someone with whom she shared an exceptionally close bond.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VIII. Nell’s Bringing-up Is Begun P43](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0043)_

## Relationships

### [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/lettie-marchant--nell-harcourt.md)

Lettie Marchant's relationship to [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) stems from Nell's origin as an imaginary friend created from a reflection in a bookcase door. While [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) participates in local social events, such as attending tea at the manse with a girl named [Lauretta](../character/lauretta.md) Bradley and sharing news with [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), she remains rooted in this imagined bond established since the first volume.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VIII. Nell’s Bringing-up Is Begun P43](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0043), [v1 CHAPTER XXII. Nell Is Invited Out to Tea P1](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XXII. Nell Is Invited Out to Tea P3](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0003), +2 more_
